common_contract.execution: Research only. No wrappers, tests, imports of scientific libraries, installations, GPU, release changes or deployments were performed. All oracles are proposed analytic expectations, NOT observed results.
common_contract.safety: Future adapters must expose only named fixed upstream kernels or allowlisted OTB launchers; never user-selected modules, callables, shell commands, arbitrary code, remote URLs or network downloads. Bound arrays, windows, iterations, memory and output paths.
common_contract.geospatial: Georeferenced inputs require an explicit CRS, nonsingular affine and masks/nodata. Pairwise rasters require matching CRS, affine, shape and declared compatible units; never silently resample. Preserve the valid footprint. Full-neighborhood algorithms must reject incomplete patches or explicitly erode valid support. Do not replace nodata with numeric zero.
common_contract.nongeospatial: Laboratory/array-only images must explicitly declare a pixel coordinate frame; never manufacture a CRS. Microscopy physical scaling requires a calibrated positive isotropic pixel/voxel pitch and named length unit.
common_contract.artifacts: GeoTIFF only for outputs with a valid image grid and explicit output mask/nodata; CSV for scores, features and audit tables; PNG is a labeled preview, never a substitute for numeric artifacts. Non-spatial transform domains must not inherit a map CRS.
common_contract.provenance: Future calls record package/version/commit, input hashes, declared units, parameters, masks/valid counts, registration assumptions, sensor metadata and artifact hashes. All examples/oracles here are synthetic.
common_contract.scientific_limits: No optical texture, score, class, fused radiance or scatterer parameter is ore identification, mineral concentration or grade. No hidden fill, automatic calibration constants or imputed physical quantities.
common_contract.compatibility: Keep Python3.12/numpy2.1.3/scipy1.15.3/pandas2.3.0/matplotlib3.10.7/rasterio1.4.3 and shared installed pins unchanged. All new binary or unresolved transitive dependencies are private CPU worker proposals, not approved installations.

operations.scientific_task: Recover spatially continuous phase from a wrapped interferometric phase image.
operations.scope: Two-dimensional reliability-based phase unwrapping with a fixed random seed; output remains phase, not inferred displacement or elevation.

units.output: radian; arbitrary component-wise integer multiples of 2*pi

constraints: Finite valid pixels; nonempty connected support for a single-reference result.
Bound image dimensions; fix rng; declare wrap_around rather than inferring periodic geography.
Disconnected components have independent phase offsets; never claim absolute phase.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Preserve input CRS/affine and masked support using the upstream masked-array API; retain component/reference metadata.

numeric_oracle.construction: An 8x8 array has analytic phase phi(r,c)=pi*c/2; wrap into [-pi,pi). Compare within the same row, independently of the global offset.
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Spatial continuity plus increments smaller than pi determines a 7*pi/2 phase difference; no second unwrap implementation.

operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoRemotePhaseRegistration estimates a global translation; it does not unwrap interferometric phase. None of original229 or prior four group candidates recovers phase-cycle continuity.
operations.risk: Medium: discontinuities, disconnected masks and phase-gradient aliasing make physical interpretation nonunique.

operations.scientific_task: Invert calibrated monochromatic thermal spectral radiance to blackbody brightness temperature.
operations.scope: Single wavelength or explicitly independent wavelength channels; not land-surface temperature, emissivity correction, atmospheric correction or sensor-band integration.
constraints: Strictly positive finite wavelengths and radiance; reject per-micrometre radiance unless explicitly converted.
Use NumPy arrays as required by the kernel; bound dimensions and physically declared wavelength range.
No fetching spectral response files; no invented emissivity or atmospheric parameters.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Pointwise conversion retains CRS, affine and valid mask; reject missing/incompatible radiance units.

numeric_oracle.construction: At wavelength=1e-5 m, calculate synthetic radiance analytically from Planck's law at T=300 K using the exact modern SI h,k,c constants. Feed only this radiance and wavelength to the upstream inverse.
numeric_oracle.proposed_tolerance: 0.001 K; upstream uses older h,k constants
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Forward blackbody law evaluated from independent SI constants, not the upstream forward helper.

operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing raster scale/offset and indices do not invert thermal radiative physics. GeoRemoteSensorBandResample resamples reflectance spectra rather than estimating brightness temperature.
operations.risk: Medium: additional private dependency lock unresolved; narrowband approximation and old physical constants must be disclosed.

constraints: Same acquisition geometry and explicit prior registration; matching arrays and compatible amplitude units.

numeric_oracle.construction: On a finite all-valid patch, reference=1+0i and match=exp(i*pi/3). Evaluate interior windows, excluding padding.
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: The normalized sum of identical unit phasors is exp(i*pi/3), independent of implementation.

operations.scientific_task: Assign supplied spectral classes using trained class means, full covariances and priors.
operations.scope: Supervised maximum-likelihood spectral classification with explicit training masks; output labels inherit supplied meanings, not automatic mineral identities.

units.spectra: consistent per-band radiance or reflectance units

constraints: Training counts must exceed band count and satisfy min_samples explicitly; reject rather than silently omit under-sampled classes.
Finite positive-definite, well-conditioned class covariances; positive normalized priors.
Same band definitions/order and calibration in training and prediction; no training/prediction leakage in validation.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Align training labels and cube exactly in CRS/affine/shape; exclude nodata training pixels and preserve prediction mask.

numeric_oracle.construction: Class1 contains (0,0),(2,0),(0,2),(2,2); class2 translates these by (10,0). Equal priors. Query spectrum (11,1).
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Both covariances equal diag(4/3,4/3); query is the class2 mean and is 10 units from class1 mean.

operations.distinct_from_existing: SAM is angular reference similarity and RX is one-background anomaly scoring. SLIC partitions spatial superpixels; none trains full Gaussian class distributions for supervised spectral labels.
operations.risk: Medium: singular covariance, class omission and probabilistic-model mismatch; class labels are not validated composition.
operations.license: MIT

operations.scientific_task: Discover representative observed spectral endmembers from an image or spectrum matrix.
operations.scope: One SMACC discovery workflow, returning selected signatures and reconstruction diagnostics; not an additional supplied-library unmixing solver.
constraints: Bound rows<=4096 and bands<=32; require finite nonnegative bounded reflectance.
Requested endmember count must not exceed numerical rank or available spectra.
Set internal max_residual_norm=Infinity and bounded min_endmembers=K to terminate after K selections; never expose JSON nonfinite values.
Upstream warns about reconstruction error for large values; reject unsupported inputs rather than silently replacing the kernel.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Collect only valid spectral vectors; preserve original pixel/source indices and wavelengths. Signatures are CSV, not georeferenced rasters.

numeric_oracle.construction: Input spectra are (1,0),(0,1),(0.5,0.5), with K=2. Compare selected endpoints as an unordered set.
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: The two coordinate axes are the unique extreme rays; their equal mixture has coefficients 1/2 independently of selection order.

operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoSpectralLinearUnmix requires pre-supplied endmembers. This discovers observed extreme signatures; proposed OTB VCA is deliberately not also counted.
operations.risk: Medium: library selection is not mineral identification; bounded termination and numerical rank need CPU acceptance.

operations.scientific_task: Quantify Bhattacharyya separation of two trained spectral-class distributions.
operations.scope: Distribution-overlap diagnostic for evaluating training classes/band choices; one metric family, not separate covariance/mean terms or aliases.

units.input: compatible spectral units in each band

constraints: Two labeled populations, enough samples for positive-definite class covariances.
Identical band schema; finite values and bounded class/sample count.
No arbitrary vector distance dispatch; only the fixed Gaussian class diagnostic.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Raster class samples must share grid and valid-mask alignment; output is class-pair CSV, not a spatial anomaly map.

numeric_oracle.construction: ClassA uses the four corners (0,0),(2,0),(0,2),(2,2). ClassB translates A by (2,0). Unbiased covariance is diag(4/3,4/3).
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Equal covariance cancels the determinant term; the mean-separation contribution is (1/8)*(2^2)/(4/3)=3/8.

operations.distinct_from_existing: RX and GeoGeochemBackgroundDistance score observations against one background. This compares two full labeled class distributions including determinant/covariance differences.
artifacts: sample counts and covariance diagnostics CSV
operations.risk: Medium: Gaussian assumption and covariance conditioning; not an error-rate guarantee.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate a spatially varying displacement field between registered-view grayscale images.
operations.scope: Dense TV-L1 motion, not an alternative global translation estimator; no inference of ground velocity without time and geometry.
constraints: Two finite 2D intensity arrays, identical shape/grid and documented comparable brightness.
Bound warps, iterations and image size; reject categorical labels.
Report occlusion/brightness-constancy limitations; never fill missing motion as zero.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: For initial integration use complete valid patches; retain their grid. Conversion to map-unit displacement needs explicit affine-vector mapping, not degree-to-metre guesses.

numeric_oracle.construction: Let f(r,c)=(sin(.17*r)+cos(.13*c)+.2*sin(.11*r+.23*c))/4.4+.5 on a 128x128 patch. Reference=f(r,c), moving=f(r-1,c-2). Compare median interior flow on rows/cols32:96.
numeric_oracle.proposed_tolerance: proposed 0.3 pixel; convergence tolerance NOT calibrated by execution
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Analytic translation of a continuous textured field fixes the true correspondence without using an image-warp or registration kernel.

operations.distinct_from_existing: GeoRemotePhaseRegistration estimates one global translation. This estimates local deformation fields, and is not a parameter variant of that global task.
operations.risk: Medium-high: nonunique texture/occlusion and solver convergence; analytic target known, numerical tolerance still requires CPU acceptance.

operations.scope: Eight-degree-of-freedom homography estimation; not a GIS CRS transform or automatic ground orthorectification.
constraints: At least four non-collinear pairs, bounded coordinates/count, positive finite weights if supplied.

numeric_oracle.construction: Generate six or more non-collinear pairs from H=[[1,0,2],[0,1,3],[.1,0,1]]. Hold out source point(10,4).
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Direct homogeneous projection gives (12/2,7/2), independent of fitting routine.

operations.scientific_task: Detect localized bright features and estimate their characteristic image scale.
operations.scope: Scale-normalized Laplacian-of-Gaussian extrema; not threshold connected-component measurement or inferred geological objects.
constraints: Finite scalar intensity image; positive bounded sigma grid and thresholds.
Isotropic sampling for circular-radius interpretation; otherwise retain pixel scale only.

numeric_oracle.proposed_tolerance: center<=0.5 pixel; selected scale expected3, subject to discrete CPU acceptance
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: For a circular Gaussian the continuous scale-normalized LoG response is maximal at filter sigma equal to object sigma.

operations.scope: One bounded orthogonal2D Haar pyramid for multiscale texture analysis; no separate axis/mode tools and no claimed denoising.

constraints: Fixed wavelet='haar', mode='periodization'; finite full-valid2D image.

operations.scope: Equal-band-count MAD initially, using full-rank joint spectral statistics; not an extra PCA, RX or scalar difference wrapper.
constraints: Same grid and jointly valid complete patches, same band count for initial scope.
More observations than combined dimensions; positive-definite conditioned marginal covariances.
Return component order/sign conventions; reject singular cases instead of ridge-regularizing silently.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Source requires matching origin, spacing, size and projection. Preserve joint mask; estimation samples and output valid counts must be explicit.

numeric_oracle.construction: Construct four mutually orthogonal zero-mean synthetic sample columns with sample variance1. X=(u1,u2); Y=(.5*u1+sqrt(.75)*u3,.25*u2+sqrt(.9375)*u4).
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Marginal covariances are identity and cross-covariance diag(.5,.25); Var(U-V)=2*(1-rho).

operations.risk: High OTB dependency; statistical stationarity, training contamination and component sign/order require explicit handling.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate H/alpha/anisotropy scattering descriptors from reciprocal full-polarimetric SAR.
operations.scope: One incoherent H-alpha-A decomposition; no separate decomposition-mode counts or automatic lithology classes.
constraints: Monostatic reciprocal data; matching polarization grids and units.
Positive total coherency power; bounded spatial mean radius; finite outputs.
Source parameter inco.kernelsize is passed to SetRadius, hence width=2*value+1 despite ambiguous documentation.
Require real outputs within tolerance before discarding negligible complex storage parts; disclose eigenvalue degeneracy.
operations.crs_mask_nodata: Use jointly valid complete averaging windows and preserve the eroded mask/grid.

numeric_oracle.construction: Use a period3 pixel pattern of Pauli vectors (3,0,0),(0,sqrt(6),0),(0,0,sqrt(3)); invert to reciprocal HH/HV/VV analytically. A9x9 interior window (radius4) has average coherency diag(3,2,1).
numeric_oracle.proposed_tolerance: 1e-6 for H/A, 1e-4degree for alpha; A has upstream1e-6 denominator stabilizer
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: Eigenvalues3,2,1 give probabilities1/2,1/3,1/6 and known coordinate eigenvectors. Shannon entropy/base3 and weighted angles follow analytically.

operations.scientific_task: Predict return power for explicit transmit/receive polarization states from full polarimetric scattering measurements.
operations.scope: Four-band HH,HV,VH,VV input initially; one physical synthesis task, not one operation per Jones-vector angle.
constraints: Exactly ordered full-polarization channels with consistent calibration, grid and time.
Finite allowed orientation/ellipticity angles; bounded arrays.
No automatic dual-polarization completion and no absolute RCS claim; application docs mention gain but no gain parameter is exposed in pinned application.

numeric_oracle.construction: A synthetic scattering matrix S=identity with transmit and receive both horizontal (all four angles0degrees).
numeric_oracle.independent_basis: The Jones-vector contraction [1,0]*I*[1,0]^T has amplitude1 and power1.
